scope: Remaining full Core test failures in conversation trace, authenticated workspace resource listing, and concurrent duplicate tool execution
changes: Trace fixture keeps required presence markers and verifies existing identity, sparse trace update, and canonical persisted row without weakening creation validation.
Configured backend ListResources delegates to runtime workspace Store; authenticated HTTP test asserts saved agent name while existing JWT/cookie/401 expectations remain.

Coalescing test uses explicit owner/provider hold and confirmed active waiter instead of a mock mutex plus sleep that serialized credential preflight; expected one provider execution and both completed histories retained. Test conversation recorder protects concurrent writes.

coalescing_race.includes: unprotected coalescing, protected duplicate bypass, shared error persistence

limitations: A broader full toolexec race attempt exposed additional asynchronous test fixture reads outside their locks; the focused affected concurrency cases pass with race detection.
Checks used the private local framework modfile; root owns final published dependency and whole Core acceptance gates.
